ignoreCommand: [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "preview" ] && [ "${VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF#dependabot/}" != "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" ] || { [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ] && [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && { git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || git fetch -q --depth=1 origin "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA"; } && git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- . ; }
